title: Summer Lovin' Singles Party at Rye Hotel
summary: Melbourne Singles Ball hosts a ticketed singles night at Rye Hotel on Friday 23 October. Doors open at 8pm for music and dancing; the organiser says the night is aimed at people aged 25 and over.
verificationNote: The event-specific Eventbrite page returned HTTP 200 on 12 October 2026. Its structured event data confirms Friday 23 October, 8pm, Rye Hotel and organiser Melbourne Singles Ball. The listing says pre-sale tickets are required, doors open at 8pm and the night is aimed at a 25+ audience. Eventbrite's date range extends into Saturday but supplies no closing hour. This record shows the confirmed Friday attendance date only, so it does not imply a separate Saturday session. Rye Hotel's own page confirms the venue address. Recheck the organiser page for ticket terms and availability.
suitableFor: Adults looking for a singles social night; organiser says the event is aimed at people aged 25 and over
editorVerdict: A Friday night to meet other singles and dance at Rye Hotel. Doors open at 8pm; book ahead and check the organiser's current terms.
editorNote:
Melbourne Singles Ball describes a social night with arrival glow bands and DJs playing dance, R&B and party music. The organiser says it is aimed at people aged 25 and over. It is a pre-sale ticketed event, with doors opening at 8pm on Friday 23 October at Rye Hotel, 2415 Point Nepean Road.

Eventbrite shows a Friday-to-Saturday date range but does not publish a closing time. We list the confirmed Friday start, not a separate Saturday session or an invented finish. Check the event page for current ticket terms, availability and any change before travelling. Food or a room at the hotel is separate from admission to the party.
